title: Four-variance naturality of the external evaluation transpose
statement: For braided closed monoidal categories X,Y,P, a monoidal category B, adjunctions c_X⊣s_X,c_Y⊣s_Y,c_P⊣s_P, lax monoidal functors F:X→P and G:Y→P, comparisons α:c_P≅c_XF and β:c_P≅c_YG, and a natural tensor comparison δ for c_P, pull back the two adjunction evaluations, tensor them with the Koszul interchange, and transpose at P. The resulting pairing is contravariantly natural in E,H and covariantly natural in K,L, exactly as NaturalityAt states. The lemma pairing_eq_pairingOf identifies this pairing with the original generic pairingOf construction. The three original generic factories retain their fully qualified names and signatures. The auxiliary externalPulledEvaluationOf is the same two pullEvaluationOf composites followed by externalEvaluationOf and the target map, formed before specializing the categories.

source.place: Stacks Tags 08J9 and 0A90: adjunction, evaluation and tensor naturality; the categorical formal calculation is written out in Lean. Tag 0G7E for the pulled evaluation construction.

proof.text: Naturality of the constant comparison and of the lax tensor constraint transports an evaluation naturality equation through pullEvaluationOf. Naturality of δ, tensorμ, and tensor composition transports two such equations through externalEvaluationOf.

Apply parameter, coefficient and target naturality of the transpose from [lem-pur-external-rhom-adjunction-naturality] to the preceding external evaluation equation. Substitute the two evaluation naturality identities from that lemma to obtain all four variances. Expanding the definitions proves pairing_eq_pairingOf by reflexivity.
